text:
Tara M: Put together a short checklist for SI onboarding focused on marketplace co-sell readiness + micro-cert badges. Goals: reproducible lab, one-pager for sales, and a lightweight cert (20 Q + lab validation). Review please.

Ethan C: Love the micro-cert idea. Can we make the lab reproducible in a 60-min window? Minimal infra: 1 GPU, transient bucket, and an example prompt set.

Priya S: Yes. Suggest providing a generator for synthetic input and a teardown script. Also include a support contact and SLAs for partners listed in the marketplace.

Luis P: Marketplace requires images and a 200-300 word blurb. I'll draft the blurb and example YAML for SKU and pricing tiers.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: listing must include support_email, region list, and an icon 128x128. See internal docs.

Tara M: Action items: Ethan - lab script + validator; Priya - consent & privacy checklist; Luis - listing YAML + blurb. Sync Wednesday 9am PT to sign off.

Ethan C: I'll prototype the validator with fuzzy-match thresholds and push by Tue.

Priya S: I'll draft privacy checklist and a short redaction guide.

Luis P: Will have YAML + blurb by Tue EOD.

Tara M: Thanks team :smile: I'll send invite.
